units.text: Aspose.3D FOSS for TypeScript reads and writes 3D scenes using formats such as OBJ, STL, GLTF, and FBX. It converts scenes between these formats and supports loading from files or buffers and saving to files or buffers. It provides access to scene entities including meshes, materials, cameras, and lights, along with geometry, animation, and transformation data.
Build and traverse a hierarchical scene graph with Scene and Node — every node holds a Transform, an optional entity (Mesh, Camera, or Light), and child nodes accessible via childNodes.

Construct mesh geometry with Mesh.controlPoints and createPolygon, and attach per-vertex attribute channels — normals (VertexElementNormal), UVs (VertexElementUV), and vertex color (VertexElementVertexColor) — through the VertexElement hierarchy.

Assign shading materials through Material subclasses — LambertMaterial (diffuse-only), PhongMaterial (adds specular/shininess), and PbrMaterial (metallic/roughness, mapping directly to the glTF PBR model).
Place Camera (projection type, field of view, clip distances) and Light (POINT, DIRECTIONAL, SPOT, AREA, VOLUME) entities as scene nodes.

Animate node properties with keyframes — AnimationClip groups AnimationNode tracks, each holding AnimationChannel s of KeyframeSequence time/value samples with configurable Interpolation/Extrapolation.

Read glTF (JSON and binary GLB) and Wavefront OBJ scenes, and write STL (ASCII and binary), FBX (ASCII), COLLADA (.dae, via xmldom), and glTF JSON scenes through Scene.open()/Scene.openFromBuffer() and Scene.save() — OBJ export and binary GLB export both carry real, current defects; see Scope and Limitations before relying on either.
Perform 3D transformations and calculations using FVector2, FVector3, FVector4, Matrix4, and Quaternion types.
Attach arbitrary metadata to scene objects through Property and PropertyCollection, with INamedObject providing named access to SceneObject instances.
The @aspose/3d package provides a 3D scene graph API for TypeScript. The Scene class serves as the primary entry point, offering static and instance methods to load, manipulate, and save 3D content.

Scene provides static fromFile and instance open/openFromBuffer methods to load files or buffers with auto-detected format, save and saveToBuffer to write output, and exposes rootNode to access the node hierarchy.
Node represents an element in the scene tree with a name, transform, and child nodes accessible via childNodes, and supports adding and managing entities via addEntity and entities.
Mesh holds controlPoints as Vector4 vertices and supports polygon creation via createPolygon, with triangulate converting all polygons to triangles for export.
AnimationClip holds named animation tracks via animations and provides createAnimationNode to build keyframe-based animations, with scene exposing clips at the scene level.
FileFormat provides canImport and canExport to check format support, and getFormatByExtension to resolve a format descriptor from a file extension.
Camera defines a viewpoint with projectionType, fieldOfView, nearPlane, and farPlane properties to configure perspective or orthographic rendering.
Light represents a light source with lightType, direction, and fieldOfView properties to define point, directional, or spot lighting behavior.
PbrMaterial implements physically-based rendering with albedo, metallicFactor, and roughnessFactor properties that map directly to the glTF 2.0 PBR material model.
Quaternion supports rotation representation via fromEulerAngle, interpolation via slerp, and string conversion via toString.
Matrix4 provides identity, translate, and rotate methods to construct and manipulate 4x4 transformation matrices for scene graph operations.
VertexElementUV stores 2D texture coordinates via uvData and defines mappingMode to control how UV data maps onto geometry.
Property holds a typed name/value pair with name, value, and valueType properties, attachable to any A3DObject for custom metadata.
It adds rendering, additional exchange formats, and full production feature completeness.
A3DObject class gives the name, properties, and methods to manage properties and convert to a string representation.
AnimationChannel class gives the bind point, component type, default value, and key frames for an animation channel.
AnimationClip class gives the animations, description, name, and properties for an animation clip.
AnimationNode class gives the bind points and methods to manage them and retrieve key frame sequences.
ApertureMode enum lists the HORIZONTAL, HORZ_AND_VERT and VERTICAL aperture modes.
AssetInfo class gives the name, properties, and methods to manage properties and convert to a string representation.
BindPoint class gives the channels count and methods to add, retrieve, and create key frame sequences.
BooleanOperation enum lists the ADD, INTERSECT and SUB boolean operations.
BoundingBox class gives the center, extent, infinite flag, maximum, minimum, and methods to check containment and merge.
BoundingBox2D class gives the extent, infinite flag, maximum, minimum, and methods to get center, size, and merge.
BoundingBoxExtent class gives the extentX, extentY, extentZ, finite, infinite, and null flags.
Camera class gives the apertureMode, aspect, aspectRatio, direction, excluded, farPlane, and fieldOfView properties, and the getEntityRendererKey member is not implemented.
ComposeOrder enum lists the APPEND and PREPEND compose orders.
CustomObject class gives the name, properties, and methods to manage properties and convert to a string representation.
Entity class gives the excluded flag, name, parent node, and methods to find and get properties, and the getBoundingBox and getEntityRendererKey members are not implemented.
Extrapolation class gives the repeatCount and type for animation extrapolation.
ExtrapolationType enum lists the CONSTANT, CYCLE, CYCLE_RELATIVE, GRADIENT and OSCILLATE extrapolation types.
FMatrix4 class gives the concatenate, identity, inverse, and matrix element properties m00, m01, m02, m03, and the inverse member throws Error conditionally.
FVector2 class gives the add, div, dot, equals, length, mul, normalize methods, and the add, div, parse and sub members throw TypeError or Error conditionally.
FVector3 class gives the equals, getItem, normalize, one, setItem, toString, and unitX properties, and the getItem and setItem members throw Error conditionally.
FVector4 class gives the equals, getItem, setItem, toString, w, x, and y properties, and the getItem and setItem members throw Error conditionally.
FileFormat class gives the canExport, canImport, contentType, extension, extensions, and methods to create load and save options.
FileSystem class gives the createDummyFileSystem, createLocalFileSystem, createZipFileSystem, readFile, and writeFile methods, and all of them throw Error.

Geometry class gives the addControlPoint, addElement, castShadows, controlPoints, createElement, createElementUV, excluded, and methods to find and get properties, and the getEntityRendererKey member is not implemented.
GlobalTransform class gives the eulerAngles, rotation, scale, transformMatrix, translation, and methods to convert to a string representation.
IIndexedVertexElement interface gives the indices for indexed vertex elements.
INamedObject interface gives the name for named objects.
IOExtension class is a marker for I/O extensions.
ImageRenderOptions class gives the height and width for image rendering options.
Interpolation enum lists the BEZIER, B_SPLINE, CARDINAL_SPLINE, CONSTANT, LINEAR and TCB_SPLINE interpolation types.
KeyFrame class gives the bias, continuity, curve, flat, independentTangent, interpolation, and nextInTangent properties.
KeyframeSequence class gives the bind point, key frames, name, postBehavior, and methods to manage properties.
LambertMaterial class gives the MAP_AMBIENT, MAP_DIFFUSE, MAP_EMISSIVE, MAP_NORMAL, MAP_SPECULAR, ambientColor, diffuseColor, and the getTexture member always returns null.
Light class gives the apertureMode, aspect, aspectRatio, direction, excluded, farPlane, and fieldOfView properties, and the getEntityRendererKey member is not implemented.
LightType enum lists the AREA, DIRECTIONAL, POINT, SPOT and VOLUME light types.
MappingMode enum lists the ALL_SAME, CONTROL_POINT, EDGE, POLYGON and POLYGON_VERTEX mapping modes.
Material class gives the MAP_AMBIENT, MAP_DIFFUSE, MAP_EMISSIVE, MAP_NORMAL, MAP_SPECULAR, and methods to find and get properties, and the getTexture member always returns null.
MathUtils class gives the calcNormal, clamp, findIntersection, pointInsideTriangle, rayIntersect, toDegree, and toRadian methods.
Matrix4 class gives the concatenate, decompose, determinant, equals, getItem, identity, inverse, and methods to set and get items, and the inverse member throws Error conditionally.

Mesh class gives the addControlPoint, addElement, castShadows, controlPoints, createElement, createElementUV, createPolygon, and methods to perform boolean operations, and the difference, doBoolean, getEntityRendererKey, intersect, isManifold and optimize members throw Error.
Node class provides node hierarchy management with methods to add and manage child nodes and entities.
ParseException class represents an exception thrown during parsing operations.
PbrMaterial class defines physically based rendering material properties including albedo and texture maps.
PhongMaterial class defines Phong shading material properties including ambient and diffuse colors.
PolygonModifier class provides polygon triangulation functionality.
ProjectionType enum lists the ORTHOGRAPHIC and PERSPECTIVE projection types.
Property class represents a named value with type information and extra data.
PropertyCollection class provides a collection of properties with indexing and search capabilities.
Quaternion class provides quaternion mathematics including identity, concatenation, and conjugation operations.
Rect class represents a rectangle with left, top, right, bottom, width, and height properties.
ReferenceMode enum lists the DIRECT, INDEX and INDEX_TO_DIRECT reference modes.
RelativeRectangle class represents a rectangle defined by relative offsets and scales.
RotationMode enum lists the FIXED and ORBIT rotation modes.
RotationOrder enum lists the XYZ, XZY, YXZ, YZX, ZXY and ZYX rotation orders.
Scene class provides scene management including animation clips, asset information, and property handling.
SceneObject class provides base functionality for objects in a scene including properties and naming.
SemanticAttribute class represents a semantic attribute with alias and semantic name.
SplitMeshPolicy enum lists the ADJUST and CLONE_DATA split mesh policies.
StepMode enum lists the NEXT_VALUE and PREVIOUS_VALUE step modes.
TextureMapping enum lists the AMBIENT, BUMP, DIFFUSE, DISPLACEMENT, EMISSIVE, GLOW, NORMAL and OPACITY texture mappings.
Transform class provides transformation properties including Euler angles, geometric transforms, and naming.
TransformBuilder class provides methods to build and compose transformation matrices.
Vector2 class provides two-dimensional vector mathematics including length, equality, and indexing operations.
Vector3 class provides three-dimensional vector mathematics including angle, dot product, cross product, and comparison operations.
Vector4 class provides four-dimensional vector mathematics including equality, indexing, and string representation.
Vertex class provides vertex data reading functionality for double, float, and vector formats.
VertexDeclaration class provides vertex declaration management including field addition and clearing.
VertexElement class provides vertex element management including indices, mapping mode, and reference mode.
VertexElementFVector class provides floating-point vector vertex element management.
VertexElementIntsTemplate class provides integer vertex element management.
VertexElementNormal class provides normal vector vertex element management.
VertexElementSmoothingGroup class provides smoothing group vertex element management.
VertexElementTangent class provides tangent vector vertex element management.
VertexElementType enum lists the BINORMAL, EDGE_CREASE, HOLE, MATERIAL, NORMAL, POLYGON_GROUP, SMOOTHING_GROUP and SPECULAR vertex element types.
VertexElementUV class provides UV coordinate vertex element management.
VertexElementVertexColor class provides vertex color vertex element management.
VertexField class provides vertex field definition with semantic, data type, and offset information.
VertexFieldDataType enum lists the BYTE_VECTOR4, DOUBLE, FLOAT, F_VECTOR2, F_VECTOR3, F_VECTOR4, INT16 and INT32 vertex field data types.
VertexFieldSemantic enum lists the BINORMAL, EDGE_CREASE, MORPH_NORMAL, MORPH_POSITION, NORMAL, POSITION, SPECULAR and TANGENT vertex field semantics.
Watermark class provides watermark encoding and decoding functionality.
WeightedMode enum lists the BOTH, NEXT_IN_WEIGHT, NONE, and OUT_WEIGHT reference modes.
